verdict.rationale: Tavily is a web API product, so a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec is a fair axis, but the evidence pack documents none. A probe found all common OpenAPI and Swagger paths return 404. The llms.txt file and Markdown versions of the docs are documentation formats, not a machine-readable API spec, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
